title: Gano, farashi da karewa: juya dashboards zuwa aikin da aka biya
course_title: Ikon BI da Tableau: Alamomin Kasuwancin Sadarwa

say: Gano, farashi da karewa: juya dashboards zuwa aikin da aka biya.
Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module uku na Power BI da Tableau: tuntuɓar, farashi da aikin dashboard ɗin ku.
Ƙwarewar fasaha tana samun gina dashboard. Ƙwarewar tuntuɓar yana samun amfani da ita kuma ana biya ta.
Yawancin ayyukan dashboard waɗanda suka gaza yin hakan kafin a gina kowane ginshiƙi.

say: Tsara minti 45 zuwa 60, ɗauki bayanin kula, kuma rufe wurare biyar.
Yanke shawara. Menene wannan dashboard zai taimaka muku yanke shawara? Dashboard ɗin da ya canza ba za a yi watsi da shi ba.

panel.heading: Yankuna biyar don rufe kowane lokaci
items: Yanke shawara: menene wannan zai taimaka muku yanke shawara?
Masu sauraro: wa ke kallonta, sau nawa, wace na'ura?
Tushen bayanai: a ina kowace lamba ke rayuwa?
Refresh: kowane wata, mako-mako ko kullum?

say: Masu sauraro. Wanene zai duba shi, sau nawa, kuma akan wace na'ura? Wannan yana yanke tsari da tsarin wayar.

say: Buga zuwa gidan yanar gizo a cikin Power BI, da Jama'a na Tableau, sanya aikin ku ga kowa. Yi amfani da su don bayanan jama'a kawai, ba don abokin ciniki ko bayanan ma'aikata ba.

cards.d: Buga zuwa gidan yanar gizo da Jama'a na Tableau don bayanan jama'a ne kawai. Kada kayi amfani da su don bayanan abokin ciniki ko ma'aikata.
Yana nuna kowane mai kallo layukansu kawai, amma idan aka raba ta hanyar sabis ɗin, ba cikin fayil ɗin imel ba.
Tattara ginshiƙan da kuke buƙata kawai, rufe sunaye da wayoyi, kare na'urori, share kwafi a ƙarshe.

say: Tsaro matakin-jere yana ba da damar dashboard ɗaya ya nuna kowane mai kallo layukansu kawai, kamar mai gudanarwa yana ganin jiharta kawai. Yana aiki ne kawai lokacin da aka raba ta hanyar sabis ɗin, ba akan fayil ɗin da kuka yi imel ba.

say: Dokar Kare Bayanai ta Najeriya 2023 ta tsara ayyuka ga duk wanda ke sarrafa bayanan sirri. Tattara abin da kuke buƙata kawai, rufe sunaye da lambobin waya, kare na'urorinku, da share kwafi lokacin da aikin ya ƙare.
Kada a taɓa aika shiga ko fitar da bayanai akan buɗaɗɗen ƙungiyoyin WhatsApp.

say: Misali, Chioma tana yin furucin dashboard tallace-tallace mai shafuka biyu. Ta karya shi zuwa matakai. Ganowa yana ɗaukar awanni 4. Samun bayanai da tsaftacewa yana ɗaukar 16.

say: Yanzu ta saka farashi. Kudinta na Naira 15,000 a kowace awa, misali ne kawai, ba farashin kasuwa ba.

card.title: Chioma yana farashin dashboard

say: Sa'o'i 52 yana ba da farashin tushe na Naira 780,000. Ta kara da kashi 15% na matsalolin da ba a san su ba, Naira 117,000, wanda ya zama 897,000.

card.title: Chioma yana farashin dashboard
card.note: Misali kawai, ba farashin kasuwa ba.

say: Ta zagaya zuwa kayyadadden naira 900,000 don ƙayyadaddun iyaka.
Shirin biyan ta kudi naira 450,000 kafin ta fara, 270,000 lokacin da aka amince da daftarin farko, da kuma 180,000 a mika mulki.

card.title: Chioma yana farashin dashboard
card.note: Misali kawai, ba farashin kasuwa ba.

say: Kare kuɗin ku. Yi ajiya kafin farawa, kuma karɓar kuɗi ta hanyar tashar da za a iya ganowa kamar canja wurin banki.
Yi hankali da abokan ciniki na ketare waɗanda ke aikawa da yawa kuma suna neman maido da bambancin. Wannan yaudara ce ta gama gari. Kada a taɓa raba kalmomin shiga na banki ko lambobin lokaci ɗaya.
Kuma lokacin da abokin ciniki ya nemi ƙarin, duba iyakar da aka rubuta kuma aika buƙatar canjin farashi.

panel.heading: Kare biyan ku

say: Don tunawa. Rufe dukkan wuraren ganowa guda biyar. Yi amfani da kayan aikin jama'a kawai don bayanan jama'a. Ƙididdiga ta lokaci kuma ƙara rashin tabbas.
Gina ayyukan fayil guda uku, kowanne tare da ɗan taƙaitaccen nazarin hukunce-hukuncen ku da binciken ku, kuma kada ku taɓa amfani da bayanan abokin ciniki a cikinsu.

say: Yanzu yi aiki. Gudanar da taron ganowa tare da mutum na ainihi, farashi da ba da shawarar aikin, kuma rubuta shirin mako 13 tare da lambar da za ku iya kashe kowane mako.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

items: Guda taron gano aiki
